## Recorded progress and status

The available records show Bills with both Current and Lapsed status labels, as well as dated stage entries. Those entries establish the status labels and activities recorded, not each Bill’s later progress or final fate. In particular, a Current label should not be read as proof of enactment or subsequent progress, and a Lapsed label is not a certified final outcome. A separate request for recorded final outcomes could not be answered with the available capability, so this briefing cannot establish what ultimately happened to the Bills. The source records are not certified as complete or fresh. [a-856e2814b779a4454bcd]
_Provisional interpretation — moderate qualitative confidence (provisional)_

The records illustrate why status and activity need to be considered separately. For Seanad Electoral (University Members) (Amendment) Bill 2020, they record a Bill Lapsed Event dated 2025-01-29 and Committee Stage dated 2025-03-27, alongside status Current. For Protection of Private Residences (Against Targeted Picketing) Bill 2021, they record a Bill Lapsed Event dated 2024-11-08 and Second Stage entries dated 2024-11-08 and 2025-05-01, also alongside status Current. More recent dated entries include Second Stage for Road Traffic (Amendment) (Jax’s Law) Bill 2026 on 2026-09-16 and for Artificial Intelligence Companion Services (Protection of Children) Bill 2026 on 2026-09-29. These are recorded entries, not a certified account of what followed; the available records do not explain the coexistence of the different labels and events. [a-3fafc730b5702bc1598b]
